purpose: Seed rules for finding qualified small and mid-size streetwear brands that may need private-label garment development, sample coordination, and knit material sourcing.
positiveQualitySignals: Official brand website with current apparel products.
Public contact page or wholesale page with visible email.
Recent drop, new arrivals, preorder, back-in-stock, or collection update.
Product language mentions heavyweight tees, hoodies, sweatshirts, sweatpants, coordinated sets, garment dye, or cut-and-sew.
Founder, owner, designer, creative director, production, or sourcing contact is public.
Physical address or clear market proof in a target market.
Public free-mail address appears on the official brand website and has country/product proof.
negativeQualitySignals: Marketplace, resale, directory, coupon, news, tourism, law, health, SaaS, software, web design, or generic service site.
Blank apparel wholesaler, printer, embroidery service, manufacturer, or supplier rather than a brand owner.
Search-snippet email not found on the official website.
Email domain mismatch between extracted email and official website domain.
Privacy, legal, GDPR, abuse, noreply, no-reply, Shopify system, accessibility-only, or press-only mailbox.
Contact form only with no visible email.
Policy-only page without current product evidence.
emailQualityRules: Prefer emails found on official contact, wholesale, stockists, about, or product pages.
Require product evidence before sending to role inboxes such as info@, support@, contact@, help@, sales@, shop@, or team@.
Allow Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook, Hotmail, iCloud, or Me only when the address is published on the official brand website.
Reject malformed addresses, image artifacts, and URL-derived pseudo-emails.
Skip any address already present in sent, suppression, bounce, or rejection logs.
Pause and tighten validation if bounce rate exceeds 5%.
providerSendingRules: Keep real outreach sending disabled by default in config/automation-control.json.
For QQ personal SMTP, stop immediately on the first SMTP 550.
Cap QQ personal SMTP accepted outreach conservatively until a warmed domain mailbox is ready.
Use at least 60 seconds between messages; 120 seconds is safer for cold outreach.
Run bounce and suppression cleanup before every send batch.
